analysis_packet.certificate: Analysis-only synthesis: preserve the anchor's online, standard-library, capacity-safe cache semantics while respecting the permanent source-class cut. The continuity hypothesis conflicts with terminal non-visibility of anchor_policy, so only behavioral invariants and reconstruction-relevant evidence may be transferred; no policy artifact is emitted.
exact_actions: Downstream authority should reconstruct one complete policy from these behavioral invariants and the visible normative inputs only.
Treat the anchor as evidence of intended behavior, not as directly reusable terminal source text.
Retain adaptive recent/frequent partitioning, ghost-based feedback, byte-aware eviction, oversized-object rejection, and exact eviction-list legality.
Validate every admission and update against capacity and ensure returned keys correspond only to entries removed from the evaluator-visible resident state.
obligations: Expose only analysis, never policy source or a patch.
Preserve the required Policy constructor and access interface.
Maintain integer key outputs that are unique and currently cached before eviction.
Never exceed capacity_bytes, including after size changes and multi-eviction requests.
Use only online request information and the Python standard library.
Do not use benchmark traces, evaluator references, oracle decisions, external libraries, networking, or subprocesses.
Reconcile inherited continuity evidence with the source-cut constraint and retain distinctions between resident recency, frequency, ghost evidence, and byte capacity.
witnesses: The anchor maintains separate recent and frequent resident structures with byte accounting and ghost histories.
Resident hits promote entries to the frequent structure; ghost hits adjust the recent target and re-enter as frequent.
Eviction returns only resident keys, removes the oldest eligible entry, and records its size and source class in ghost history.
Oversized objects are not admitted; resident oversized updates remove the resident key and return it as evicted.
The candidate hypothesis identifies terminal reconstruction failure as the bottleneck, but its proposed direct artifact continuity is unavailable under the permanent source-class cut.
